rationale: Capability discovery can expose a dedicated entrypoint without duplicating command parsing in tools/agent.py.
Keeping tools/agent.py focused on canonical GitOps avoids coupling the canonical bootstrap to an experimental capability.
Existing unit and live CLI probes already exercise tools/lock.py directly.
If the capability is promoted later, tools/agent.py may discover or route to it without making a wrapper a prerequisite for promotion.
supersedesProvisionalPlan: Phase 3 target that required wiring lock commands into tools/agent.py before promotion.
